name: Freaky Frida
bio: Smiles at everyone. Nobody has seen her blink.
notes: The owner's own Meshy model (Drive folder, 2026-11-01: "freaky frida lowpoly"). The download is textured but not rigged (no skin), so it is rigged here from T-pose landmarks found on the mesh (landmarks.mjs). A wide-eyed girl in pigtails, a tactical vest and camouflage shorts. Landmarks: found on the mesh, then the shoulders moved out to the arms' roots (found at the base of the neck, 6% of her height from the middle: the upper arms ran through the chest and took the vest with them, which tore at the shoulder in the hold) and the elbows a little out; `armCloth` keeps the vest's armholes on the body. Rebuilt 2026-11-05 (intake step 2b) from the re-rigged download "freaky frida rigged" (Meshy rig, Mixamo skeleton; its clips not used).
